mechanism_narrative: A current federal funds rate below 1.5% signals an accommodative monetary policy stance that reduces discount rates for equity valuation, producing positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days regardless of economic conditions.
failure_condition: FEDFUNDS < 1.5% and 20d returns are negative in >55% of cases, or Rank IC < 0.05 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: An unemployment rate exceeding 4.0% indicates labor market deterioration that suppresses consumer spending and corporate earnings growth, causing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: When UNRATE > 4.0%, 5d returns are positive in >55% of cases, or Rank IC < 0.05 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous declines in housing starts below 1250.0 thousand units and retail sales below 490.0 billion dollars indicate a broad-based demand contraction that triggers negative S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: When both HOUST and RSAFS are below their 3-month moving averages, 60d returns are positive in >55% of cases, or Rank IC for interaction term < 0.05 over any 3-year window.

mechanism_narrative: During periods of strong industrial production growth (INDPRO > 105.0), economic expansion supports corporate profits, leading to positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: When INDPRO > 105.0, 20d returns are negative in >55% of cases, or Rank IC < 0.05 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: Housing starts below 1250.0 thousand units signal a weakening housing market that reduces consumer wealth and business investment, causing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: When HOUST < 1250.0, 5d returns are positive in >55% of cases, or Rank IC < 0.05 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A Consumer Price Index above 250.0 indicates elevated inflation that triggers central bank tightening expectations, causing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: When CPIAUCSL > 250.0, 20d returns are positive in >55% of cases, or Rank IC < 0.05 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: In strong labor market expansion (PAYEMS > 150,000 new jobs), consumer spending and corporate earnings growth support positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: When PAYEMS > 150000, 20d returns are negative in >55% of cases, or Rank IC < 0.05 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A higher level of industrial production (INDPRO) indicates robust economic activity that supports corporate earnings, leading to positive S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days regardless of economic conditions.
failure_condition: Rank IC < 0.05 over any 3-year rolling window, or INDPRO > 105.0 and 5d returns are negative in >55% of cases.
